reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups, and I almost never pay for kid activities. I'd take the free first visit maybe, but $15 a visit when I'll just be chasing my kid anyway isn't something I'd keep paying for.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and I can get the same play for free at the library or park.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap parent-and-kid session, like a pay-what-you-can morning, or a long-term price under $8 a visit.
